boundary.heading: How payment works here
boundary.body: Ustaad.com records what was agreed and what both parties confirm was paid. It does not process, hold or transfer money. Payment is made directly between the family and the tutor.

ledger.title: Payment record
ledger.emptyBody: A record is raised when the booking is confirmed, with the rate frozen as it stood at that moment.
ledger.totalsNote: Only records both parties have acknowledged count as confirmed. A single-party claim stays in the second row until the other side agrees.

line.caption: Cycle {{cycle}}
line.amountLocked: The agreed amount can no longer be changed on this record. Correct it by raising a dispute, which leaves a trail, rather than by editing a figure both people already agreed to.

family.done: The family has marked this paid.
family.pending: The family has not marked this paid yet.

tutor.done: The tutor has confirmed receiving it.
tutor.pending: The tutor has not confirmed receiving it yet.

dispute.heading: Raise a dispute
dispute.notARefund: This is not a refund request. Ustaad.com never held the money, so there is nothing here for it to return. A dispute is a written disagreement that an administrator reads and resolves in writing.
dispute.reasonHint: One line. This is what an administrator sees first.
dispute.detailHint: Optional. Write as much as you need, in whichever language you prefer.
